playbook.implementation: Use Compliance Manager CMMC assessment template to document access control policy
playbook.notes: Policy document; M365 provides template scaffolding only

playbook.implementation: Configure Entra ID as identity provider with Lifecycle Workflows for automated provisioning/deprovisioning
Create Entra ID Access Reviews for all privileged and standard access on quarterly schedule
Document account management lifecycle procedures; reference Entra ID Lifecycle Workflows as implementation mechanism
Configure Lifecycle Workflows with HR-driven triggers (Workday/SAP SuccessFactors connector or CSV-based)
Configure sign-in activity policy to disable accounts after 90 days of inactivity
Create recurring Access Reviews requiring manager sign-off for all group memberships and app assignments
Document RBAC model; export current Entra ID role assignments and app role assignments as baseline
Configure Entra ID directory roles, administrative units, and application roles per RBAC model
Export all privileged role holders from PIM; document as privileged account inventory
Configure PIM requiring justification, approval, and MFA for privileged role activation with maximum 8-hour duration
Create Conditional Access policy requiring compliant/hybrid-joined device and trusted location for admin portal access
Document SoD matrix; use Entra ID incompatible access packages to enforce
Configure incompatible access packages in Entitlement Management to prevent conflicting role assignments
Document least privilege policy; reference Entra ID PIM and Conditional Access as enforcement mechanisms
Create baseline Conditional Access policy blocking all access by default, with explicit grant policies per scenario
Schedule quarterly Access Reviews to identify and remove excess permissions
Create separate cloud-only admin accounts (admin_user@domain) without M365 license for admin duties; block admin accounts from email/Teams
Ensure non-admin users cannot access admin portals; configure Conditional Access to block non-privileged users from Azure/M365 admin centers
Configure Entra ID Smart Lockout with threshold of 10 attempts and 60-second lockout duration
Draft system use notification banner text meeting DoD/organizational requirements
Configure Entra ID custom branding with use notification text on sign-in page; deploy logon banner via Intune device configuration
Deploy Intune device configuration for 15-minute screen lock timeout; set Conditional Access sign-in frequency to 12 hours
Configure Conditional Access persistent browser session controls; disable 'stay signed in' and set session lifetime
Document critical operations requiring dual authorization (e.g., Global Admin changes, eDiscovery, DLP policy changes)
Configure PIM with approval workflows requiring a second authorized individual for critical role activations
Entra ID inherently assigns unique ObjectId and UPN to each user; verify no shared accounts exist
Configure device registration, managed identities for services, and service principals with certificates
Configure Entra ID authentication methods (password + MFA) as required authentication mechanisms
Configure Intune device enrollment with compliance policies; require Entra ID device registration
Document MFA policy specifying local, network, and privileged access scenarios where MFA is required
Create Conditional Access policies requiring MFA for all users, all cloud apps, with trusted location exceptions if needed
Enable FIDO2 security keys and/or certificate-based authentication as replay-resistant methods; disable SMS/voice
Entra ID prevents identifier reuse via 30-day soft-delete; verify soft-delete is not bypassed
playbook.notes: Entra ID inherently prevents UPN reuse for 30 days after deletion

playbook.implementation: Configure automated script or Lifecycle Workflow to disable accounts after 90 days of sign-in inactivity
Configure Entra ID Password Protection with custom banned password list and minimum 14-character length
Entra ID cloud-only users use NIST 800-63B guidance (no periodic rotation, banned password list); for hybrid, configure AD password history
playbook.notes: Microsoft recommends eliminating periodic password rotation per NIST 800-63B; use banned passwords + MFA instead

playbook.implementation: Configure Temporary Access Pass (TAP) with one-time use and defined lifetime for initial authentication
Entra ID stores passwords using PBKDF2 with per-user salt (inherent); verify no legacy hash storage
playbook.notes: Entra ID inherently uses approved cryptographic hashing; document verification

playbook.implementation: Entra ID sign-in page inherently masks password input; verify custom apps also mask
playbook.notes: Inherent M365 behavior; verify any custom applications also comply
